pkgmetadata.longdescription: Comfy Desktop is Comfy Org's official desktop application for ComfyUI, the node-based engine for generative AI. It creates and manages self-contained ComfyUI installs (each with its own Python, PyTorch, models and custom nodes), keeps them updated, and takes snapshots for rollback. This package installs the upstream amd64 Electron .deb payload under /opt/comfy-desktop; it does not build the application from source. The ComfyUI environments the app provisions are downloaded on first use into the user's home directory and are not managed by Portage.
